exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Subjunctive — were I to, should it, had we

items.prompt: ___ we to accept those terms, we would need a concession.
items.hintAfterError: Só uma dessas formas combina com 'to + verbo': é o subjuntivo de 'be'.

items.prompt: ___ the price hold above sixteen cents, everything changes.
___ we known earlier, the strategy would have been different.
items.hintAfterError: Condicional no passado invertida: o auxiliar do past perfect vai para o início.

items.prompt: Were I ___ a five-year contract, would you commit on volume?
___ both sides agreed in Q3, the deal would be closed by now.
